A failed carrier trace may move the case to a specialist.

contexts.text: A package is considered delayed when it has no tracking update for three business days beyond the latest estimated delivery date. At that point, support may open a carrier trace. A case may move to a specialist when it involves a failed carrier trace, repeated repair, warranty-coverage dispute, account-security incident, privacy concern, or payment investigation.
